create_make_device: create a torch.device object from a string or torch.device, resolving cuda index
build_get_device_tensor: build a torch.device from a tensor's device or fall back to a specified default device
test_make_device_string: test make_device with a string argument like 'cuda' or 'cpu' and verify the returned torch.device
refactor_get_device_fallback: refactor get_device to support non-tensor inputs with an explicit device override
review_make_device_cuda: review make_device behavior when cuda is specified without an explicit index
